sentences.ar: جحا انعزم على عزيمتين بنفس الليلة.
sentences.en: Juha was invited to two dinners on the same night.
He did not know where to go.
He went to the first and ate a little.
And then he went to the second and ate again.
He came home tired with his stomach hurting.

sentences.ar: قال: مرة وحدة أحسن من مرتين.
sentences.en: He said: once is better than twice.
